summary: Smith & Nephew PLC filed a Form 6-K attaching a TR-1 notification from Cevian Capital II GP Limited, disclosing a passive cross of a holding threshold. Cevian reported a 13.206621% aggregate voting stake (111,788,454 shares) as of 25-Jun-2026, up from 13.056468%. The stake is held via Cevian Capital II Master Fund L.P. (12.018425%) and a co-investment vehicle (1.188196%). Shares are held through Aurora Nominees Limited and custodian UBS AG. The filing is for transparency under UK rules. Cevian is a known activist investor; while no demands are stated, the build-up suggests potential engagement. Watch for public activist proposals or board discussions.
